about: What scripts/pcb_check.py and factory_check.py hold this board to, besides the fab profile. 'nets' is the design intent from the README, written by hand: the schematic must match it exactly. 'approved' findings stay in the report with their reason and stop counting as problems; each one is a decision, not an oversight. Tokens are a part's pin (U1.G4) or pad (SW1.3); a switch's pin 1 is pads 1 and 3, pin 2 pads 2 and 4, so both pads are named.

approved.why: ESP32 pins this board does not use: EN has its own pull-up and RST button on the DevKitC; SVP, SVN, G34, G35 are input-only pins left free (proposed 2026-11-19, confirmed by the owner 2026-11-20)
M3 screw holes: plated is fine for a screw

approved.match: BZ1, DISP1, SW1, SW2, SW3, SW4, SW5, SW6, U1
approved.why: a kit soldered by hand from the owner's own parts: no assembly is ordered
